budget_items.what_was_recorded: The year ended with a net income surplus before non-routine items and including subsidy.
budget_items.quote: we ended the year with a net income surplus of $37,697 before non-routine and including subsidy.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Non-routine expenses were close to $60,000, including $39,995 of expenses and $19,715 for a truck/plow, appliances and an on-site camera.
budget_items.quote: there were expenses of $39,995 with another $19,715 for a truck/plow purchased from leominster, appliances, and on -site camera.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The negative result from non-routine costs came from Reserves; some costs were covered by State COVID funds.
budget_items.quote: the negative $22,014 came from our reserves.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reserves stood at a percentage of the DHCD minimum, which is 35%, with no subsidy if over 100%.
budget_items.quote: reserves are at $128,583 (86.15%); minimum required by dhcd of 35% with no subsidy if we go over 100%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The January 2022 monthly report showed a surplus, with contract costs the significant item.
budget_items.quote: we are at a surplus of $4,047 so we are moving in the right direction.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Contract costs were the only significant item; spending in January was high.
budget_items.quote: the only significant item is contract costs; we spent a lot in january.
